correctness.rationale: Inscribed-angle correspondence, unique short-arc triple identity, Dirichlet spacing p=3b^2 and pair-gap kernel q(s)=(2b-s)1{s<b} give exact finite-n covariance. Canonical order-three remainder is O(n^3) in variance, and finite Fourier CLT with square-summable tails proves scaled Gaussian-chaos limit. Signs for all b via modular density/periodicity establish support. Edge n=3 and strict thresholds are correctly handled.

value.rationale: The empirical maximum-angle law over every triple of a random cyclic n-gon is a canonical dependent geometric sample statistic. Exact finite-n variance permits uncertainty quantification; the full spectral limit gives the non-Gaussian fluctuation law; the strict two-sided versus endpoint one-sided support transition is a substantive structural phenomenon not encoded in the ordinary single-triangle mean. It treats a full natural angle interval, not a hand-selected numerical slice.
